title:
Know what’s on.
Know what it costs.
description: A quick look at your household energy.
narration: Meet WattWise. An energy monitoring app for Philippine households. See what your connected appliances are using, understand estimated electricity costs, and keep your budget in view. Let's take a quick look. The readings in this demonstration are sample data.

captions.text: Meet WattWise.
An energy monitoring app for Philippine households.
See what your connected appliances are using, understand estimated electricity
costs, and keep your budget in view.
Let's take a quick look.
The readings in this demonstration are sample data.

title:
Appliance. Wi-Fi.
Your phone.
description: A monitoring unit connects usage to the app.
narration: It starts with a monitoring unit. The unit measures an appliance's electricity use, then sends readings to WattWise over Wi-Fi. The hardware shown here is a concept illustration. For your test session, researchers prepare the electrical connections.

captions.text: It starts with a monitoring unit.
The unit measures an appliance's electricity use, then sends readings
to WattWise over Wi-Fi.
The hardware shown here is a concept illustration.
For your test session, researchers prepare the electrical connections.

title:
Scan. Add.
Approve.
description: Connect the device and review its suggested budget.
narration: To add an appliance, scan its device code or enter its identifier. Tell WattWise how you normally use it. Then review the AI profile and suggested budget. You choose the appliance limit before approving it.

captions.text: To add an appliance, scan its device code or enter
its identifier.
Tell WattWise how you normally use it.
Then review the AI profile and suggested budget.
You choose the appliance limit before approving it.

title:
What’s running
right now?
description: Live watts, volts, current, and daily energy.
narration: On the Home Dashboard, you can see what's running right now. Check power in watts, voltage, current, and energy used today. You'll also see the estimated daily cost. When fresh readings stop arriving, the device shows as offline or idle.

captions.text: On the Home Dashboard, you can see what's running right
now.
Check power in watts, voltage, current, and energy used today.
You'll also see the estimated daily cost.
When fresh readings stop arriving, the device shows as offline
or idle.

title:
Your budget.
At a glance.
description: Spending so far, plus a projected bill.
narration: Next, open your Home Wallet. Set a household budget, check spending so far, and view your projected bill. Estimates use Meralco rate components, fixed charges, and tax. They help you track costs, but they are not your official electricity bill.

your projected bill.

title:
Spot the
pattern.
description: Daily records. Weekly summaries. Spending trends.
narration: Want to understand your usage over time? Open the calendar and Burn Analytics. Explore daily records, weekly summaries, and spending trends. Compare your connected appliances and see when usage changes.

captions.text: Want to understand your usage over time?
Open the calendar and Burn Analytics.
Explore daily records, weekly summaries, and spending trends.
Compare your connected appliances and see when usage changes.

title:
Tips you
can understand.
description: Practical Taglish guidance from your usage data.
narration: WattWise also offers practical energy insights in Taglish. These insights use your recorded data to explain usage patterns. Budget warnings and unusual-use alerts highlight changes to review. Choose the suggestions that fit your household. Actual savings will depend on how you use your appliances.

title:
You choose
what happens.
description: Approval request or optional automatic shutoff.
narration: With Smart Control, you choose what happens when an appliance reaches its approved limit. You can require approval, or enable automatic shutoff. The cutoff tracks calendar-month variable energy spending. Home-level fixed charges are excluded.

captions.text: With Smart Control, you choose what happens when an appliance

The cutoff tracks calendar-month variable energy spending.
Home-level fixed charges are excluded.

title:
Review it.
Export it.
narration: Need a record of your usage? Open Energy Reports, choose a period, and download a PDF or CSV. In Settings, manage your account, billing cycle, and notification preferences. Push notifications require your permission and service availability.

title:
Try it.
Be honest.
description: Tell us what is clear, confusing, or useful.
narration: Now, it's your turn to try WattWise. Complete the assigned tasks. Tell us what feels clear, what feels confusing, and what you would actually use. Answer the survey based on your own experience. There are no right or wrong answers.
